526.description: A mammet inspired by a hero of the Thirteenth, who wandered alone for millennia after her world was consumed by Darkness. Sharing her taste in cuisine, the Hannish artisan responsible poured their heart into its creation and ensured accuracy in every detail, such as the scythe she wields from her days as an avatar.
526.col_2: I will let it burn,<hex:02100103>this fire in my breast.<hex:02100103>   - Zero
526.col_4: Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

527.name: Summon your wind-up Erenville minion. Happy to follow rather than guide you for a change.
527.description: A complementary companion to an illustrated encyclopedia, this automaton was commissioned by the Studium's publications department as part of a recruitment campaign for gleaners. Though designed in the likeness of Erenville, the man himself was not consulted on its creation on account of being afield at the time.
527.col_2: Don't try to fool an expert.<hex:02100103>   - Erenville
527.col_4: Increases ATK of all allies within range by 10.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

528.name: Summon your Nano Lord minion. The land probably won't tremble before his might.
528.description: A diminutive manifestation of the Shadow Lord, which arose from the core of his memories in the wake of battle. While the original Shadow Lord was a dreaded existence in the world of Vana'diel, where he led the Beastman Confederate in a war of conquest against the Enlightened Races, this entity thankfully appears to pose no danger.
528.col_2: Minions of the Shadow Lord!?<hex:02100103>   - Iroha

529.name: Summon your uma-no-unicolt minion. Wishes to embark on a journey with one who is pure of heart.
529.description: On the occasion of the Heavensturn celebration, House Fortemps helped to secure the loan of this unicorn young to serve as the mascot for the visiting Far Eastern delegation. Though initially nervous to be away from home, the creature was able to find its stride at your side, and there it appears content to remain.
529.col_2: The unicorn must have<hex:02100103>sensed kinship in you.<hex:02100103>   - Braya
529.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 to all enemies within range while increasing action party ATK by 20.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s

530.name: Summon your Adamant Weapon minion. A diamond by any other name would shine as bright─at least when scale is accounted for.
530.description: Retrieved from an imperial base, this scale prototype of a warmachina appears to have been created for counter G-Warrior testing and carries no armaments. After completing their analysis, the Eorzean Alliance saw fit to bestow it upon members as a reward for exemplary service.
530.col_2: 'Twould require a heart as hard as diamond<hex:02100103>to raise one's voice in anger to beings<hex:02100103>possessed of such profound...saccharinity.<hex:02100103>   - Urianger
530.col_4: Delivers 8% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

531.name: Summon your toco toquito minion. A tropical bird that is all beak and has a squawk to match.
531.description: Inhabiting the tropical forests of Tural, the toco toquito is most notable for its prodigious beak, which is deceptively light on account of being hollow. Further identifiable by its blue-ringed eyes and the reddish emblazoning upon its hind, it is also fondly referred to as the jewel of the forest.
531.col_2: Why, this is it! The very<hex:02100103>jewel I spoke of!<hex:02100103>   - Sula
531.col_4: Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

532.name: Summon your shshuye minion. One day it may become a dread tural vidraal, but it is not this day.
532.description: Its name meaning “leaping sun” in the Shetona tongue, this variety of jackrabbit native to Yyasulani is held by the Shetona people to be a distant relative. In the past, a fearsome tural vidraal emerged from this otherwise harmless species and terrorized the people of Yuweyawata.
532.col_2: Clearly, you are at a complete loss as to<hex:02100103>the identity of the virile gentle-rabbit<hex:02100103>who stands before you!<hex:02100103>   - Godbert
532.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

533.name: Summon your spinettesaurus minion. Small though it may be, never let it be said that it has no spine.
533.description: The young of a prehistoric reptile, this creature possesses protruding spines that are likened to a sail, which it uses to regulate body temperature and perform courtship displays. In contrast to its stunted forelimbs, it is blessed with powerful legs that allow it to move quickly and snatch up prey in its elongated jaws.
533.col_2: So long, spiny whatever-you-are.<hex:02100103>   - Languid Lominsan
533.col_4: Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>monsters<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 5s

534.name: Summon your wind-up Pelupelu minion. The perfect souvenir, if it does say so itself.
534.description: A series of this automaton was crafted by a potsworn goldsmith to serve as a promotional souvenir for the Pelupelu-run Turali Travel Agency. While the use of Kozama'uka lumber lends it a homespun appearance, it moves in a highly lifelike manner thanks to the advanced mechanisms within.
534.col_2: The Pelupelu value the act of<hex:02100103>spreading joy through trade.<hex:02100103>   - Erenville
534.col_4: Delivers 10% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

535.name: Summon your tin soldier S3 minion. The toy with a body of tin and a heart of gold.
535.description: Boasting remarkably expressive movements despite its old-fashioned design, this tin soldier was brought to Limsa Lominsa on a vessel that plies the trade route west. According to the merchant who acquired it, such pieces were made in the likeness of a soldier of a bygone and faraway kingdom.
535.col_2: I shall have to examine one of<hex:02100103>these mechanical soldiers later.<hex:02100103>   - Y'shtola
535.col_4: Transports action party to the central summoning Gate.

536.name: Summon your Deathservant minion. Literally has a taste for life.
536.description: In the course of being used in ritual sacrifices to ward off famine, this ancient stone dagger awakened as a malevolent spirit driven by an insatiable hunger for life force. By journeying with you and absorbing the essence of felled fiends, it is hoped that it will be able to suppress its murderous urges.
536.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

537.name: Summon your wisp of Darkness minion. What it cannot smother, it nibbles. What it cannot nibble, it tickles.
537.description: In the course of recalling your ferocious battle with the Cloud of Darkness, this curious mammet somehow came to be in your possession. While its design is highly reminiscent of the works of the notorious goldsmith who crafted the wind-up succubus, there is no way to ascertain the truth of its origin.
537.col_2: I can't begin to imagine how<hex:02100103>powerful it must have been.<hex:02100103>   - Ryne
537.col_4: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

538.name: Summon your wind-up Themis minion. A minion as loyal as your star is bright─a minion not bound by the confines of this world, or any other.
538.description: Designed in the likeness of Themis, two of these mammets were produced at Professor Claudien's behest, with one being delivered by your own hands to Erichthonios. Cutting-edge Sharlayan techniques were employed in its fabrication, that it might not look amiss in the world of the ancients.
538.col_2: Were my eyes mistaken?<hex:02100103>Was that Themis?<hex:02100103>   - Erichthonios
538.col_4: Inflicts a weakness to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poppets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

539.name: Summon your Lawnblazer minion. Railroad not required.
539.description: Created by Xak Tural Railing as part of a publicity campaign, this toy locomotive marries a simple and warm design with spirited movement. So well received was the product by staff members, the company is entertaining the possibility of venturing into toy manufacturing in earnest.
539.col_2: Behold, the pinnacle of<hex:02100103>locomotive engineering!<hex:02100103>   - Shenza
539.col_4: Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

540.name: Summon your Psamathe minion. An entity born of the fire-wielding familiar Triton. That's the red one.
540.description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Triton, the fire-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its intelligence has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
540.col_2: You would be well advised to ask<hex:02100103>yourself: can I stand the heat?<hex:02100103>   - Charlys
540.col_4: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

541.name: Summon your Naiad minion. An entity born of the ice-wielding familiar Nereid. That's the purple one.
541.description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Nereid, the ice-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its sense of morality has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
541.col_2: I have no doubt that it is capable<hex:02100103>of chilling victims to the bone!<hex:02100103>   - The Impresario
541.col_4: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

542.name: Summon your Deimos minion. An entity born of the poison-wielding familiar Phobos. That's the green one.
542.description: This peculiar entity appears to have manifested from Phobos, the poison-wielding familiar that served among the collective of three that controlled the weather on the Occult Crescent. Though its sense of propriety has faded over the course of long years, in this diminutive state, it should largely be harmless.
542.col_2: Well, of course they'll be poisoned!<hex:02100103>How else would I gauge the efficacy<hex:02100103>of your work?<hex:02100103>   - Severian
542.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 120 and knocks back all enemies within range.

543.name: Summon your boon baboon minion. May sound like a generous creature, but don't expect any favors.
543.description: The male of this species of baboon is identifiable by the luxurious growth of fur around its shoulders, which gives the impression of a mantle. In stark contrast, its buttocks are completely bare, with plump, red cheeks on display for all and sundry to see. In certain parts of the Far East, baboons are regarded fondly by avid readers due to their cry resembling the local name of a popular work of fantasy.
543.col_2: This clearing is currently as bare<hex:02100103>as a white baboon's buttocks.<hex:02100103>   - Felicitous Furball
543.col_4: Reduces HP of enemy Shield by 70%. No effect if Shield is already inoperable.

544.name: Summon your clockwork oppressor. Painted a rugged shade of green, this miniature machina is a scale replica of the full-size model deployed in military training exercises.
544.description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Astragalos oppressor in tiny, toylike form. On account of its considerable bulk and heft, however, it failed to find willing merchants for distribution, and was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
544.col_2: We shall cast down the oppressors!<hex:02100103>   - Chalteaufite
544.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

545.name: Summon your Ja Tiika leafkin minion. What lies beneath its glowing blue leaves is best left a mystery.
545.description: Among the blue leafkin that inhabit Yak T'el, this particular creature is friendly to men, and dwelled near a settlement in the Ja Tiika Heartland. While superstition persists that that their kind are Mamool Ja who have been cursed, some believe that they are in fact pure souls who were reborn as guardians of the forest.
545.col_2: Have you heard of blue leafkin?<hex:02100103>   - Prudent Hunter
545.col_4: Inflicts a weakness to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>monsters<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

546.name: Summon your Gulool Ja Ja minion. It watches your progress with great interest.
546.description: Designed in the likeness of Gulool Ja Ja, this mammet was created to commemorate the seventieth anniversary of his ascension as Dawnservant. It would seem that those Mamool Ja who journeyed to Eorzea brought these units with them with the intent of impressing upon the locals the glory of their kind.
546.col_2: Gulool Ja Ja, mightiest<hex:02100103>of the blessed...arise!<hex:02100103>   - Zereel Ja
546.col_4: Increases ATK of all allies within range by 20 (40 if the ally is a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poppet<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>).<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

547.name: Summon your micro rover minion. Won't be moving mountains, but can handle pebbles with aplomb.
547.description: This miniaturized model of a utility vehicle used in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative was produced for the amusement of young children. While it faithfully incorporates all the functions of the original machine and can perform various tasks, it lacks the power to move anything beyond pebbles.
547.col_2: Looking for a ride on<hex:02100103>the burrow's best rover?<hex:02100103>   - Drivingway
547.col_4: Reduces action points of all enemies within range by 50% of the maximum value.

548.name: Summon your tipping tortoise minion. Would be a generous tipper if its coins were real.
548.description: This tortoise possessed of a gleaming golden shell appears to be the offspring of the trade tortoise, the creature that sought to peddle cursed artifacts on the Occult Crescent. On account of its tender age, however, it is not yet permitted to handle legal tender, and must make do with imitation coins.
548.col_2: I'd almost forgotten what it was like to<hex:02100103>feel the weight of coins in my pocket...<hex:02100103>   - Eismon
548.col_4: Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 5s

549.name: Summon your royal hound minion. As loyal as it is royal.
549.description: This bright-eyed canine is believed to be descended from hounds that were once bred by the royal family of Alexandria for hunting foxes and deer. Fiercely loyal by nature, it had long sought a worthy master to serve, and appears to have found one in you.
549.col_2: You've got the nose of a bloodhound.<hex:02100103>   - Midnight Dew
549.col_4: Renders all allies within range immune to attacks by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>monsters<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

550.name: Summon your Skallic uolosapa minion. A winsome bird with pure white feathers and a pink beak.
550.description: In ages past, the uolosapa was brought from the south sea isles to the nation of Skalla, where it quickly gained popularity as a pet. In the course of being bred in captivity, a specimen emerged that possessed pure white feathers, the descendants of which have been treated as a variety unto themselves to this day.
550.col_2: I seem to have made<hex:02100103>a feathered friend.<hex:02100103>   - Fufucha
550.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

551.name: Summon your Seikret fledgling minion. Dreams of the day it attains rugged good looks and colorful feathers.
551.description: The fluffy young of a Seikret, a beast of burden native to a faraway world. While full-grown creatures look imposing with their sharp countenance and bright plumage, chicks are plump and white in contrast, and cut a winsome figure scrambling after their masters as they train to become fully fledged mounts.
551.col_2: Is that a hint of melancholy I detect in thy<hex:02100103>voice? Something akin to a pining mother<hex:02100103>bird whose chicks have flown the nest...<hex:02100103>   - Urianger
551.col_4: Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

552.name: Summon your Vigorwasp minion. Rest assured it won't dump its sac of nectar on you.
552.description: Thought to have arrived from another world, this variety of wasp is unique for hoarding nectar in an impressively large sac on its abdomen. In its native land, it primarily harvests the nectar of Vitalilies, whose healing properties make the creature sought after among seasoned hunters out in the wilds.
552.col_2: So many ideas, like a swarm of<hex:02100103>wasps...making the mind race.<hex:02100103>   - Lost Chirurgeon
552.col_4: Restores 100 HP to all allies within range (150 if the ally is a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>critter<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>).

553.name: Summon your model suit minion. Comes complete with pocket-sized pilot.
553.description: This meticulously handcrafted toy is modeled on the vacuum suit developed for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Rumor has it the initiative was approached by a certain machina enthusiast from Garlond Ironworks, whose unbridled passion for the suit paved the way for the production of these miniaturized units.
553.col_2: These vacuum suits are a sight to behold...<hex:02100103>   - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member

554.name: Summon your wind-up Yok Huy minion. Gazes out into eternity with eyes unblinking.
554.description: With the cooperation of the Pelupelu, their business-minded neighbors, the Yok Huy produced a series of this mammet as a souvenir for visitors to Zirgorteh the Open-armed. Boasting nimble movement ordinarily unseen on their stout physique, it has also proven popular among the Yok Huy themselves.
554.col_2: We shall soon come face-to-face─<hex:02100103>or rather, face-to-knee─with those<hex:02100103>enormous Yok Huy.<hex:02100103>   - Alphinaud
554.col_4: Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 5s

555.name: Summon your raven-red gobtank. Faster than the blue one.
555.description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Ravens-colored Astragalos gobtank in tiny, toylike form. Though originally meant to be marketed with the permission of the goblins, negotiations broke down over the profit margin, and it was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
555.col_2: Pshhh... Gobbies whack<hex:02100103>for Ravens muchly!<hex:02100103>   - Goblin Mercenary
555.col_4: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

556.name: Summon your falcon-blue gobtank. Stronger than the red one.
556.description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the Falcons-colored Astragalos gobtank in tiny, toylike form. Though originally meant to be marketed with the permission of the goblins, negotiations broke down over the profit margin, and it was ultimately repurposed as an allied training trophy.
556.col_2: Pshhh... Gobbies whack<hex:02100103> for Falcons muchly!<hex:02100103>   - Goblin Mercenary
556.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

557.name: Summon your wind-up Eald'narche minion. After ten long millennia, the dreams of the Zilart will become reality!
557.description: A diminutive manifestation of Eald'narche, which arose from the core of his memories in the wake of battle. While the original Eald'narche was a cunning mastermind who threatened the world of Vana'diel with his brother, Archduke Kam'lanaut, this entity thankfully appears to pose no danger.
557.col_2: Have you the strength to<hex:02100103>find the answers you seek?<hex:02100103>   - Eald'narche
557.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, reduces the movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.<hex:02100103> <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s <hex:02100103> <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

558.name: Summon your rroneek calf minion. Has tusks and horns and isn't afraid to use them.
558.description: The young of a hulking herbivore native to the continent of Tural. The patterns upon the faces of juveniles are pale and uneven, but gain in boldness and definition as they age. Even if they are still small, the creatures leave their parents' side when both their tusks and horns have sufficiently developed, as is the case with this calf.
558.col_2: Look at you all, shaking<hex:02100103>like rroneek calves!<hex:02100103>   - Nitowikwe
558.col_4: Increases ATK of all allies within range by 25.<hex:02100103> <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s

559.name: Summon your oglop minion. Its unsettling gaze bespeaks intelligence...but surely it's only your imagination.
559.description: The oglop is a variety of insect that has existed in the Ninth since ancient times. While considered a noxious pest in urban centers such as Everkeep, it is viewed with more leniency by folk in the countryside, who prize the rare oil that can be harvested from its glossy wings.
559.col_2: You wouldn't believe the<hex:02100103>trouble they can cause.<hex:02100103>   - Uaauashe
559.col_4: Increases caster ATK by 10 and DEF by 5 for every 5% of HP lost.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s

561.name: Summon your micro crow minion. Clever and loyal─what more could one ask for?
561.description: This crow found at a laboratory within the Meso Terminal was formerly an experimental subject. After researchers vanished from the facility, it managed to survive thanks to its cage's emergency power supply and automatic feeding system. Possessed of great intelligence and a strong sense of duty, it has decided to follow its liberator.
561.col_2: This would solve all our<hex:02100103>problems in one fell swoop!<hex:02100103>   - Benathaire
561.col_4: Knocks back all enemies within range.

562.name: Summon your wind-up Feo Ul. As your lovely branch, it will lend you its strength!
562.description: This automaton designed in likeness of Feo Ul, a pixie of the First, was brought into being through the magicks of none other than the newly crowned Titania themself, who desired that you might always have your beautiful branch at your side. Its irrepressible cuteness and charm are true to life.
562.col_2: Come what may, your beautiful<hex:02100103>branch will ever be at your side.<hex:02100103>   - Feo Ul
562.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 180 to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

563.name: Summon your sunray ray minion. Its eyes are up here.
563.description: A variety of stingray native to Yok Tural, so named for the way it is believed to pierce the clouds like a ray of sunlight. On account of its majestic movement and its underside having the appearance of a friendly face, it has come to be worshipped as a guardian deity by the peoples who dwell by the waters of Zorgor.
563.col_2: This may sting a little.<hex:02100103>   - Honey B. Lovely
563.col_4: Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 5s

564.name: Summon your mini yan minion. A sheep spirit whose child-pleasing form and diminutive size belie its might.
564.description: According to legends in the Ninth, this peculiar creature is a sheep spirit that, despite its adorable form, strikes fear into the hearts of all who encounter it. Though this particular entity appears to have taken a liking to you, you would do well to remember that it is possessed of unknowable power.
564.col_2: Yer sheep's got magical powers?<hex:02100103>   - Traveling Merchant
564.col_4: Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

565.name: Summon your gimme kitten minion. An ill-mannered winged feline fiend that wants everything.
565.description: This mischief-loving fiend said to mimic spirits in the Ninth is known to have a liking for precious stones, which it will brazenly demand from those it encounters. Though its mood will turn foul if refused, neither will satisfying its desire win you its gratitude, so there is little to be gained from knowing it...but here we are.
565.col_2: Gimme an elixir!<hex:02100103>No, that's not right...<hex:02100103>   - Magic Pot
565.col_4: Removes all beneficial effects from all enemies within range.

566.name: Summon your sin beaver minion. Another mystery better left unsolved.
566.description: A mysterious being that appeared in Pilgrim's Traverse. When sin eater meets giant beaver, which one becomes the other? Whatever may be the truth of its existence, some mysteries only deepen the more one ponders them...
566.col_2: 'Tis truly a mystery among mysteries.<hex:02100103>   - G'raha Tia
566.col_4: Reduces DEF of all enemies within range by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

567.name: Summon your little mermaid minion. Wishes to be a little part of your world.
567.description: Legends pertaining to mermaids are common in the Corvos region, foremost among them the tale of a mermaid princess who falls in love with a man. Perhaps influenced by said tale, this diminutive entity born of an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript has chosen to accompany you on your journeys.
567.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 60 to all enemies within range while reducing movement speed by 70%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

568.name: Summon your magic lamp minion. Phenomenal cosmic powers in an itty-bitty living space.
568.description: Manifesting from an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript, this oil lamp appears to be home to a genie. Unlike the lamp-dwelling spirit of Corvosi legend that grants wishes, however, this one is hesitant to show itself, perhaps needing more time to decide whether you are a worthy master.
568.col_2: It's probably some source of phenomenal<hex:02100103>cosmic power that's key to his plans.<hex:02100103>   - Cid Garlond
568.col_4: Increases action party movement speed by 30%. <hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

569.name: Summon your Droningway minion. No Loporrit will go missing on its watch.
569.description: Modified to serve as an autonomous search and rescue unit, this transport drone is equipped with a reinforced robotic hand that takes hold of lost Loporrits for secure conveyance back to base. When no one is missing, it is programmed to pass the time by tracking random individuals.
569.col_2: The moon will be as safe as safe can<hex:02100103>be once the drones are refurbished.<hex:02100103>   - Brawny Loporrit
569.col_4: Reduces movement speed of all enemies within range by 70%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 5s

570.name: Summon your G-Warrior MGSD minion. The “MGSD” part of its name supposedly stands for “Master Garlond Superior Design,” or something along those lines.
570.description: An Ironworks machina enthusiast has replicated the G-Warrior in tiny, toylike form. Boasting incredible detail despite their diminutive size, these units are being offered as an allied training trophy as part of a publicity campaign for the Garlond Ironworks.
570.col_2: I present Garlond Ironworks' adaptation<hex:02100103>of the Ultima Warrior, the G-Warrior!<hex:02100103>   - Cid Garlond
570.col_4: Renders both ally and enemy Shields and Search Eyes inoperable. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

571.name: Summon your La Noscean shorthair minion. Will hunt rodents for board and lodging.
571.description: This variety of feline originating from Vylbrand is identifiable by its plush grey fur, and owing to their talent as rodent hunters, they have long been considered a sailor's best friend. Recently, they have been found inhabiting the Occult Crescent, perhaps the descendants of creatures that arrived aboard grounded vessels.
571.col_2: Heeere kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty!<hex:02100103>   - Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic
571.col_4: Delivers 10 points of damage every second to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

572.name: Summon your gallant shepherd minion. Courageous and loyal, it does credit to caninekind.
572.description: Since olden times, this robust breed of canine has served men as sheep and guard dogs both, and sailors are known to take them on voyages for protection at ports of call. Recently, they have been found inhabiting the Occult Crescent, perhaps the descendants of creatures that arrived aboard grounded vessels.
572.col_2: As a shepherd leads his flock, I shall<hex:02100103>guide you to my irrefutable conclusion!<hex:02100103>   - Hildibrand

573.name: Before you stands a rare bloom: the single white rose of Wutai─the one and only Yuffie! Summon your wind-up Yuffie minion.
573.description: Legends tell of a sprightly shinobi maiden who wielded an enormous shuriken. A materia hunter by trade, she was not above stealing in order to acquire her prize, yet what she desired above all was to restore her nation to its former glory. You now have the honor of serving her mammet likeness.
573.col_2: It has been far too long since<hex:02100103>I shared a shadow with a shinobi.<hex:02100103>   - Thancred
573.col_4: Triggers an enemy trap as if it were your own. If the trap deals physical damage, then potency is increased by 150%.

574.name: Summon your wind-up Vincent. Hopefully not on the verge of committing another sin.
574.description: Legends tell of a man who was subjected to dark experiments and given preternatural abilities. Upon awakening from his years-long slumber in a sealed coffin, he was haunted by his sins of the past, and chose to set forth on a journey of redemption─as his mammet likeness does now with you.
574.col_2: His is an inspiring tale of redemption.<hex:02100103>   - Makoto
574.col_4: Delivers an attack 5 times the potency of the caster's ATK.

575.name: Summon your wind-up Red XIII. He is that which you see before you. Nothing less.
575.description: Legends tell of a four-legged beast, one of the last of his long-lived kind, who was possessed of reason and capable of speech. After escaping his captivity at a research facility, he cast aside his specimen designation, and with his new comrades went on to fight for the fate of the very star.
575.col_2: I saw a flash of red in that instant.<hex:02100103>   - Lalah Jinjahl
575.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 80 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 13%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s

576.name: Summon your Grooving Green minion. Can you keep up with the rhythm?
576.description: An electrope doll designed in the likeness of Dancing Green, the grooviest fighter in the Arcadion's cruiserweight division. Harnessing the soul of a terrible toad, he possesses a supremely supple body and the stamina to dance the night away. Join in the excitement at the arena and obtain limited-edition merchandise!
576.col_2: On the dance floor, everyone's a star!<hex:02100103>   - Dancing Green
576.col_4: Renders ally Gates, Shield, and Search Eye impervious to damage.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

577.name: Summon your Mistic condor minion. Feed it only perfectly cooked flesh, lest you incur its displeasure.
577.description: A large bird native to the Mist Continent that feeds on the flesh of dead animals. Formerly devouring only raw meat, the environment of the Ninth led its kind to develop a taste for lightning-seared morsels, and it is known to patiently wait for its prey to be struck by a lightning bolt.
577.col_2: I had to dodge some lightning<hex:02100103>bolts, but I made it!<hex:02100103>   - Trainee Hunter
577.col_4: Delivers 5% damage to the nearest enemy Arcana Stone.

578.name: Summon your soothing sea-beast minion. To simply behold its pleasing form is to be soothed to the soul.
578.description: Born of an arcane pattern in an illuminated manuscript, this entity assumes the likeness of the young of a sea creature native to the Corvosi coastline. The pastel hues of its iridescent skin allow it to blend in with the coral reefs it calls home, and it is believed to be kin to mermaids.
578.col_4: Reduces ATK of all enemies within range by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 15s

579.name: Summon your Senor Otter minion. An otter and a gentleman.
579.description: This automaton brings the odder otter to life in the gentlemanly attire of Senor Sabotender, one of the Gold Saucer's beloved mascots. Masterfully crafted by the inimitable Godbert Manderville for an event, it was distributed among select collaborators, with proceeds to go towards otter conservation efforts.
579.col_2: This is the legacy of the very<hex:02100103>first Senor Sabotender!<hex:02100103>   - Nanaphon

580.name: Summon your little blue viking minion. Formerly red and vicious.
580.description: This automaton was deployed in Astragalos campaigns until it was inevitably incapacitated by adventurers. While such units are often damaged beyond repair, this example proved salvageable, and it was repurposed as an escort. Formerly red and vicious, it is now possessed of a calm temperament.
580.col_2: I borrowed this arena viking for<hex:02100103>you to demonstrate a few spells.<hex:02100103>   - Martyn
580.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 and knocks back all enemies within range.

581.name: Summon your little red viking minion. Formerly blue and ruthless.
581.description: This automaton was deployed in Astragalos campaigns until it was inevitably incapacitated by adventurers. While such units are often damaged beyond repair, this example proved salvageable, and it was repurposed as an escort. Formerly blue and ruthless, it is now possessed of a gentle temperament.
581.col_2: The Goldsmiths' Guild provides many<hex:02100103>of the mechanical combatants.<hex:02100103>   - Royse
581.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 230 to all enemies within range.

582.name: Summon your junior jinbei minion. A baby whale shark by any other name would be just as calm and carefree.
582.description: In the Far East, whale sharks are known as jinbei-zame on account of their markings, which resemble those typically seen on the jinbei, a traditional summer garment. This young creature is exceptionally placid by nature, and has taken to following you in hopes of being led to new waters.
582.col_2: The Navigator waits for<hex:02100103>no man─or shark!<hex:02100103>   - Foerzagyl
582.col_4: Reduces HP of closest enemy Gate by 90%. No effect if Gate is already inoperable.

583.name: Summon your lite-loader minion. Can move huge loads, a little at a time.
583.description: This meticulously handcrafted toy is inspired by the warp loader developed for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Like the popular model suit, it was produced by the engineers of Garlond Ironworks, and is intended to form part of a collectable series of interstellar construction vehicles.
583.col_2: These spongoi don't stand a chance<hex:02100103>against a warp loader going full throttle!<hex:02100103>   - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member
583.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 300 to all enemies within range. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

584.name: Summon your caprino minion. So adorable you'll let it get away with anything.
584.description: Originating from the region of Corvos, this variety of goat spread north alongside Garlean migration, and products made with its milk were once common in the imperial capital. This young creature appears to have lost its master in the chaos of civil war, and it now looks to you to protect and pamper it.
584.col_2: The cranky old goat<hex:02100103>will have my hide.<hex:02100103>   - Theopauldin
584.col_4: Delivers an attack 5 times the potency of the caster's ATK.

585.name: Summon your tiny omniscient minion. Knows a tiny little bit about all things.
585.description: This diminutive, bearded entity was born of the Index, master of the Occult Crescent and self-proclaimed knower of all things. A loyal familiar to those it chooses to serve, it excels at keeping track of one's reading progress in a book, but a lack of depth in its knowledge makes it useful for little else.
585.col_2: My uncle knows everything. So I do too!<hex:02100103>   - Boisterous Boy
585.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 180 to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

586.name: Summon your puny mage minion. If you think it weak...you would be right.
586.description: The puny mage was created with the goal of further miniaturizing a spellcasting mammet developed in the nation of Mhach during the twilight of the War of the Magi. While looking the part, its diminutive core means it cannot channel sufficient aether to wield magicks, and it ended up as simply a toy.
586.col_2: Did the captain receive a blow<hex:02100103>to the head while we were in Mhach?<hex:02100103>   - Cait Sith
586.col_4: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

587.name: Summon your wind-up Wuk Lamat minion. An adventurer like you could hardly resist, no?
587.description: This automaton designed in the likeness of Wuk Lamat was commissioned by a certain member of the royal family to commemorate the anniversary of her father's ascension. When the celebrations were delayed due to the rite of succession, however, the units were exported to Eorzea instead.
587.col_2: There is no stopping the<hex:02100103>Third Promise, is there?<hex:02100103>   - Krile
587.col_4: Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 20s

588.name: Summon your Laudouble minion. A beast assuming the form of a mammet assuming the form of Lauda.
588.description: Though appearing to be a mammet made in the likeness of the beastmaster Lauda, this entity is squishy to the touch and is in fact some manner of soft-bodied creature with a knack for mimicry. By all indications, it hid itself among a pile of prizes in a ploy to make its way into your company.
588.col_2: It's double trouble for the challenger!<hex:02100103>   - Metem
588.col_4: Reduces minion summoning recast time by 50%.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

589.name: Summon your wind-up Prishe minion. Ya ready for this?
589.description: This diminutive manifestation of Prishe arose from a fragment of electrope, which was left behind when her echo incarnation faded away. She had come to love this world as a second home, and this entity may well be the materialization of her desire to remain here.
589.col_2: Prishe has taken the lead, but<hex:02100103>we won't be outdone, surely?<hex:02100103>   - Alxaal
589.col_4: Increases action party movement speed by 30%. <hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

590.name: Summon your wind-up köttr minion. Because you can never have too many bipedal felines.
590.description: The catlike kettir are known for their mastery over wind magicks, but being as free-spirited as the winds they command, it can be a considerable trial to spur them to any sort of action. This being an automaton likeness, however, it should at least follow you obediently.
590.col_2: I am but an innocent traveler with<hex:02100103>a fondness for our feline friends.<hex:02100103>   - Feline Fanatic
590.col_4: Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Activation Delay:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 10s

591.name: Summon your budvi minion. A bud, buddy, and Nagylvi rolled into one.
591.description: This diminutive relic of the Nagylvi was brought forth by their knowledge construct, which had awakened with the reactivation of Auxesia's city systems. First introduced simply as a “terminal,” it was given its present name following consultation with Namingway, in the hope that it will see you through on your journeys.
591.col_2: Not only the “budvi,” but the forest,<hex:02100103>the city...all of it is joined at the roots.<hex:02100103>   - Mumukko
591.col_4: Changes action party auto-attacks to area of effect attacks.<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 12s

592.name: Summon your wind-up Barret minion. There ain't no gettin' offa this train we on!
592.description: Legends tell of a man who, driven by an unwavering sense of justice, led a resistance movement that sought to bring about lasting change in society. Despite being intimidating in appearance, he also possessed a kind-hearted side, and cherished his homeland and daughter above all else.
592.col_2: Watch the barrel, dodge the bullet.<hex:02100103>   - Hardiboiled

593.name: Summon your Nymian uolosapa minion. A winsome bird with cinnamon markings on a canvas of white.
593.description: In ages past, the uolosapa was brought from the south sea isles to the nation of Nym, where it quickly gained popularity as a pet. During this time, an unusual specimen with light-brown markings arrived on a merchant vessel from Meracydia, and it became established as a distinct breed.
593.col_4: Increases ATK of all allies within range by 25.<hex:02100103> <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s

594.name: Summon your musical paca minion. Has an instrumental burden to carry so never skips leg day.
594.description: This alpaca cria is the offspring of creatures that were kept as pack animals by traveling musicians. The time it spent with the troupe gave it a taste for the itinerant lifestyle, and it was immediately drawn to you. Every day, it trains its legs in hopes of being able to carry heavy instruments like its parents.
594.col_2: Ugh, why did it have to be alpacas...<hex:02100103>   - Wuk Lamat
594.col_4: Grants 10 action points to all allies within range who do not have similar actions.

595.name: Summon your lolly cat minion. Smells as sweet as it looks.
595.description: This stray feline once prowled the Studium's grounds until an experimental sweetener, surreptitiously eaten, turned the markings on its coat a distinctive pink, and it began giving off a sweet scent. Feeling responsible for its state, the researcher put out a call for adoption in academic journals.
595.col_2: Nothing is sweeter than<hex:02100103>the fruits of one's labors.<hex:02100103>   - Fahrafahr
595.col_4: Delivers an attack with a potency of 30 to all enemies within range while reducing DEF by 30%.<hex:02100103> <hex:024804F201F803><hex:024904F201F903>Duration:<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> 6s
